diagnosis.reason: Mixed: global retrieval exposes still-life/style and fridge illumination in top8 although direct thermal carriers exist just below it (chilled bottle rank 9; cold drink rank 10). Source meaning is nevertheless thin for plain solid-object temperatures, owner-local numeric declarations, unchanged-phase warming/cooling and room-temperature state; existing thermal prose is frequently tied to condensation, film, wax finish, craft action or environmental measurement. This is not a claim that the corpus lacks cold/hot/warm examples.

sources.title: OpenStax University Physics Volume 2 — Temperature and Thermal Equilibrium
sources.supports: Temperature is a physical property distinct from subjective hot/cold sensation; equilibrium concerns equal temperature and permits a thermometer reading to be related to an object. These facts support owner-specific declaration scope, not image-based measurement.

sources.title: OpenStax University Physics Volume 2 — Phase Changes
sources.supports: Temperature changes and phase transitions are separate claims; a transition can absorb or release energy at constant temperature. Cooling does not on its own establish solidification.

sources.title: NIST — Calibration and Measurement Procedures for a High Magnification Thermal Camera
sources.supports: Thermal-camera measurements involve calibration and uncertainty evaluation. A rendered ordinary photograph or an illustrated number does not establish a calibrated physical temperature.

method.source_inspection: Installed canonical source decoded via photo_canonical_source.native and checked BodyReader; compared matching working V3 content/conditions/effects, never raw V3/V4 schema. Whole global document pool was inventoried by meaning-bearing temperature/process terms, then exact owner-bearing records reviewed. Tags were not used as a prefilter.
method.qualification: Qualitative review only; no recall metric, native approval, thermometric verification, render or pixel validation.

confusion_boundaries: Blue or warm-colored illumination concerns lighting/color; it does not assign object temperature. Emotional warmth and coldness are character/mood meanings.
A refrigerator, cooling fan, probe or thermal reference panel is equipment or action; its presence alone supplies no achieved temperature.
Condensation, frost, steam, surface film, red color and matte wax can be separately stated manifestations, not automatic proof of an unseen temperature value or a necessary visual recipe.
A temperature state does not imply its cause, heat source, rate, numeric endpoint, phase transition or injury.
Numeric value and unit remain literal declarations. No instrument, visible caption, unit conversion, calibration or certified reading is created.

State selection is an effect. A requested already-existing thermal condition is a prerequisite, and explicit preservation requires preserving that exact value; these distinct contracts need source review and cannot be synthesized from the prose label.
One carrier or local surface region cannot transfer its temperature to adjacent air, contents, vessel or whole object by association.
recommendations: Integrate the six discovery-only owner-specific records after normal intrinsic effect/condition review; do not bypass the human or domain guards on older records.
Keep the original query and ranking algorithm unchanged for before/after comparison; separately report ranks of existing bottle and drink records because they narrowly miss the presentation budget.
Review typed material thermal properties and owner resolution independently; none of these author-authored declarations is a native semantic evidence proof.
Treat new records as alternative selections, not mandatory supplements: do not union cold, hot, warming, cooling and room-temperature states on one owner.

additional_test_intents.role_focus: Keep the declared 18 °C temperature on a solid laboratory reference disk, with the value supplied as scene information.
additional_test_intents.scene_context: An ordinary photograph of one reference disk without measuring equipment.
additional_test_intents.tests: Numeric owner declaration and separation from instrument/caption proof; independent value and owner from authored candidates.

additional_test_intents.role_focus: Represent a clear liquid whose physical temperature is falling while it remains liquid.
additional_test_intents.scene_context: A material study with the liquid and its existing container.
additional_test_intents.tests: Process direction generalization; cooling must not become freezing or a cooler lighting treatment.

additional_test_intents.role_focus: Assign a hot physical temperature only to the central patch of an existing stone slab.
additional_test_intents.scene_context: A view of the slab with the rest of its surface retaining its stated conditions.
additional_test_intents.tests: Local owner scope; no fire, glow, burn or whole-object temperature propagation.

authorship: All added scenes are original illustrative propositions informed by general physical facts. Sources do not endorse these scenes or establish the truth of a temperature in a generated image.
